subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A piece of cake
solution:
The correct answer is: A very easy task.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom ""a piece of cake"" means that something is **very easy to do or accomplish**.
 
• This phrase originated in the early 20th century and is believed to have come from the idea that cake is a simple and enjoyable dessert that requires little effort to make or eat.
 
• Therefore, option 3 is the correct meaning of the idiom. Options 1, 2, and 4 do not accurately reflect the meaning of the phrase.
